listen_addr.description: IP address on which to listen for incoming entropy requests.

listen_port.description: Port to listen on for entropy requests.

entropy_source_path.description: Path to the primary entropy source device (e.g., /dev/hwrng, /dev/urandom).

fallback_entropy_source_path.description: Optional path to a fallback entropy source (leave blank to disable fallback).

min_pool_size.description: Minimum bits of entropy required in the internal pool before serving requests.

max_draw_bits.description: Maximum number of bits per request (set to 0 for unlimited).

workers.description: Number of worker threads for gathering entropy in parallel.

metrics_enabled.description: Enable or disable Prometheus-compatible metrics collection.

metrics_addr.description: Address to bind the metrics endpoint (only used if metrics are enabled).

metrics_port.description: Port for the metrics endpoint (only used if metrics are enabled).

log_level.description: Minimum log level (e.g., debug, info, warn, error).

log_file.description: Optional file path to write logs (if omitted, logs to stderr).

report_hostname.description: Custom hostname/FQDN to report in logs and metrics (if omitted, auto-detected).

allowed_clients.description: List of allowed client IP addresses or CIDR ranges (empty = allow all).

items.description: IP address or CIDR range allowed to request entropy.

tls.description: TLS configuration for secure entropy delivery.

key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM).

ca_file.description: Optional path to CA certificate file for client cert verification (PEM).

burst_size.description: Maximum burst size (requests allowed in short spikes).

backends.description: List of entropy backends to use (e.g., hardware RNG, remote service).

url.description: For 'remote' backends: URL of entropy source (e.g., https://entropy.example.com/)

health_check_path.description: HTTP path for health-check probes (returns 200 OK if healthy).

readiness_path.description: HTTP path for readiness probes (returns 200 OK only if entropy pool is sufficient).

shutdown_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for graceful shutdown before forcing termination.

refresh_interval.description: Seconds between automatic entropy pool refreshes.

stirring_enabled.description: Enable stirring (mixing entropy from multiple sources).

buffer_memory_limit.description: Maximum memory (in bytes) for internal buffers (0 = use system default).

compression_enabled.description: Enable compression of entropy data before export (e.g., gzip).
